title: Breathable Mesh Cat Harness, Locking Buckles, Reflective Edging
bullets: Dual thickened stainless steel D-rings for attaching a leash
Locking buckles that stay firmly fastened on walks
Dual side slide adjusters and a one-touch side buckle for quick fitting
3D air mesh fabric that is breathable and soft to the touch
Reflective edge strips add visibility on night walks
description: Walking a cat on a leash takes a harness that fits and stays put. This vest-style cat harness has locking safety buckles that stay firmly fastened. Dual side slide adjusters let you change the length for a range of chest sizes, and a one-touch side buckle makes it quick to put on and take off. Dual thickened stainless steel D-rings give you two attachment points for a leash. The body is 3D air mesh fabric, which is breathable and soft. Reflective edge strips add visibility on night walks. Each harness ships in a plastic bag. If you want a breathable cat harness with reflective edging, this one is worth a look. Taking your cat for a walk can be simpler with a harness that adjusts and has locking buckles. The adjusters cover various chest sizes across small, medium, and large cats. Check the shipping estimate before you order.

faq.q: How do I size the harness?
faq.a: It has dual side slide adjusters for various chest sizes, and it is made for small, medium, and large cats. Measure your cat's chest before you order.
The body is 3D air mesh fabric that is breathable and soft. The D-rings are thickened stainless steel.
Estimated 3–7 business days to the US, plus processing 1–3 days. These are estimates, not guaranteed delivery dates.
